content: {"kind":"plan","text":"给你排了一套 12 分钟的开胯入门：先用站姿、坐姿的小活动把髋关节叫醒，再做内收、髋前侧、臀部的静态拉伸，中间配两个臀部小力量。按默认值来：居家、瑜伽垫加椅子、难度 1（入门），全程慢慢呼吸，别憋气。","plan":{"schemaVersion":1,"source":"ai","title":"开胯入门 12 分钟","summary":"活动度热身、六个方向拉伸，加两个臀部小力量，居家入门。","goal":"mobility","scene":"home","equipment":["mat","chair"],"level":1,"targetMinutes":12,"avoid":[],"blocks":[{"id":"b1","name":"热身","type":"warmup","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"n-pelvis-circle","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"h-hip-gate","mode":"reps","sets":1,"reps":6,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"s-9090","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":10}]},{"id":"b2","name":"主训练","type":"main","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"s-butterfly","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":40,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"s-kneel-hipflex","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"s-figure4","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"w-clamshell","mode":"reps","sets":2,"reps":15,"perSide":true,"restSeconds":30},{"exerciseId":"n-seated-squeeze","mode":"time","sets":2,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":30}]},{"id":"b3","name":"放松","type":"cooldown","rounds":1,"restBetweenRoundsSeconds":0,"items":[{"exerciseId":"h-knee-hug","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":30,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10},{"exerciseId":"s-seated-fold","mode":"time","sets":1,"workSeconds":40,"perSide":false,"restSeconds":10}]}],"notes":["时长、场所、难度都用了默认值（12 分钟、居家、难度 1），想加长或换办公室版随时告诉我。","拉伸停在轻微牵扯感就好，不用追求幅度，呼吸保持均匀。"],"safetyNotes":["出现疼痛、刺痛、麻木或放射感就立刻停下，缩小幅度或跳过该动作。","不适加重请停止训练，必要时咨询医生或康复师。"]}}
